provenance.rationale: Compose the route heading from the Word Iguazu Falls visit on the Argentine side and onward flight to Buenos Aires.

blocks.text:
After breakfast, drive to the Argentine side of the falls, where numerous viewpoints and walkways bring you face to face with the sheer power of the water, in a rainforest home to butterflies, monkeys and colourful birds. Then transfer to the airport for your flight to Buenos Aires.

The vibrant capital of Argentina combines European elegance with Latin American zest: colourful neighbourhoods, a passion for dance, juicy steaks in the city’s renowned parrillas and a glass of Malbec, the country’s signature wine.
